subject: Jev role settled per owner — gate retired, one lens-reading cognitive tool built and run live (round 11): the model never called it; the finding is that capacity without invitation stays idle
result: Owner design calls applied: (1) jev is the fast large-scale classification instrument, not a closure referee — CloseCheck::Jev removed, QL_CLOSE_CHECK is self|model, gate instrument wiring deleted (round-9 arm D remains reproducible at 64331c1/3112f29). (2) One cognitive tool, not twelve: lens_reading added to the loop (condition ql-lens = founding six + lens_reading; RunMode::Lens; d3a773a + admission fix d04dbc2; 114/114 tests, clippy clean). The instrument (experiments/ql-runtime/comparison/series1/instruments/jev-lens-reading.mjs, cache copy live) sends the subject to jev-latest with the classification thread's LENS_QUESTION verbatim and returns the full twelve-lens distribution; live smoke OK (L4' 0.32 with standing-pair mass, ~670ms). Tool errors are ordinary tool results — a failed reading does not fail a trial, and a reading records as a residue without moving the active position. ROUND 11 (runs/2026-09-20-glm-round11-lens/ + READING.md, commit 26d51df): 5/5 objective checks pass across main run + retries, 22 model calls / 41,401 tokens, lens_calls=0 in every trial — given the reading tool, the model never names a subject. Finding: availability alone does nothing; extends the situate result to a pattern (tools get used when the work's structure demands them — list/read/write/tests demanded, close required, situate and lens_reading idle). Design implication recorded for the owner: a reading happens only if something in the work wants it — an office whose procedure includes taking a reading, material that references it, or close itself. VARIANCE: model endpoint hung twice at ~213s (RESTRAINT both passes, SKILL once) killing the adapter with empty stderr; failed records preserved as *-variance-fail-endpoint.json; direct repro succeeded in 3s; solo reruns clean. NEXT (owner's call): what counts as an invitation — reading as part of an office's procedure, part of the material, or part of close. NOTHING PUSHED, NOTHING MERGED: techne/deep-conjugate-allowance @ 26d51df local (21 commits ahead of origin/main); human review over rounds 5-11 stays with the owner.
